title: Detailed Claims Data
publisher: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Benefits Administration
location: Claims Inventory, Claims Backlog, and Accuracy status reports
limitations: Dynamic page. Values change weekly. Claim-based accuracy is the share of sampled cases that were error-free; it is not a wrongful-denial rate.

title: FY 2025 Annual Benefits Report: Compensation
publisher: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Benefits Administration
reporting_period: Fiscal year 2025; recipients as of September 30, 2025
limitations: Counts recognized service-connected disabilities, not every condition claimed or experienced. Veteran population is based on VetPop2023.

title: FY 2027 Congressional Submission: Budget in Brief
reporting_period: FY 2025 actual, FY 2026 enacted/estimated, FY 2027 request
limitations: FY 2027 values are requested or projected, not enacted outcomes.

title: FY 2027 Congressional Submission, Volume III: Benefits and Burial Programs and Departmental Administration
limitations: Projected claims include PACT Act workload, while the direct-labor FTE table cited in the document excludes Toxic Exposures Fund FTE. This observatory therefore does not treat that table as a complete productivity denominator.

title: 2025 VA AI Use Case Inventory
limitations: An inventory entry is a use case, not necessarily a unique software system. Lifecycle status must be considered; retired and pre-deployment entries are not running production systems.

title: Veterans Benefits: More Thorough Planning Needed to Help Better Protect Veterans Assisted by Representatives
location: Report pages addressing representative counts and ADF workforce resources
limitations: Accreditation does not establish active practice, new-client availability, caseload, language capacity, geography, or accessibility capability.

title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
limitations: This project targets WCAG 2.2 AA. Automated tests alone cannot establish full conformance.
